title: Trade approvals: a row dispatched under MD-LTR-PAPER-AUTO executes only its paper legs; its real-money/prop legs get no Approve ask
note: Found by lane TRADE-ACTION-DIRECT-PATH (session_01AFoLuJRcgEM7nWVNbrYHgx) building phase 1 (PR #25039). live_review_rows_watch.run_pass calls trade_approvals.offer only when dispatchable() returns a reason (the VM did not execute the row). A row covered by an account_scope ltr_auto_apply entry (MD-LTR-PAPER-AUTO) is dispatched, so it executes on bybit_1/alpaca_paper/ib_paper legs only, and the same call on the real-money and prop legs of that package is never offered to the operator. Fix: after a paper-scoped dispatch, offer an ask scoped to the remaining accounts (a directed record with scope per account, or package scope; the paper legs then refuse as already done). Re-entry test: a unit test with a paper-auto row on a package also carried by bybit_2 produces one ask; rerun: grep 'offer(row' src/runtime/live_review_rows_watch.py.
